title: ‘Pure insanity’: Mathematicians will need years to make sense of OpenAI’s latest drop
slides: OpenAI's latest math proof: can you trust it?
Mathematicians say it will take years to verify.
The proof may be correct, but no one understands it.
You can use it now, but blindly trusting is risky.
Demand human-verifiable proofs before you apply any.
thread_text:
1. The Proof No One Can Read

OpenAI released a math proof that may be correct, but mathematicians say verification will take years. You can use it right now — and that's the problem.

2. Trust Without Understanding

The proof's logic is so complex that even experts can't fully grasp it. You're being asked to accept a result no human can currently check.

3. The Verification Gap

Mathematicians warn that blindly applying unverified proofs can lead to costly errors. Industry adoption is racing ahead of human oversight.

4. Your Risk as a User

If you deploy this proof in production, you own the consequences. A single flawed assumption could cascade into system failures.

5. Demand Human-Checked Proofs

Before you apply any AI-generated proof, ask: can a human verify it? If not, wait. Your code's integrity depends on it.
